note: First election of the rural district council (Lurgan Poor Law Union: electoral divisions in Counties Armagh, Down and Antrim), 6 April 1899. No party labels printed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Cornakinegar' to Cornakinnegar (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Lurgan Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-37 name the DED Cornakinnegar; the rounds were filed as Cornakinegar (1899); Cornakinnegar (1902, 1905, 1908, 1911, 1914, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964). This round was filed as 'Cornakinegar', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (cornakinegar) answers with a redirect to this one.
